node.title: HGE4 ambient-order norm level cap
node.statement: For an official ambient order n=2^s and exact dyadic ratio level m=2^a|n, every primitive top shift pair of width h satisfies n^(2 floor(h/2))<(4h)^(m/4). Combined with the quarter-width theorem this gives h<=min(m/4-1,2 ceil(ma/(8s))-1). Retaining the factor 4h/m yields the parity deletion 4(25s-36)d<=25(s-a)m for even d and 4(25s-36)d+100s<=25(s-a)m for odd d. At n=2^41,m=2^40 the first potentially live defect is d=6,948,379,851. This is a proper-level width reduction, not a count of the surviving lower widths or a closure of HGE4.
